WHAT TO EXPECT

Roadside assistance

Square State Towing lists several roadside services alongside towing. Explain the problem and vehicle details on the phone. Ask which assistance is appropriate and confirm the charges before a visit is arranged.

Have these details ready

  • The symptom or problem you are experiencing
  • Vehicle year, make, and model
  • Your location and a callback number

Before you confirm

Ask about vehicle suitability, current availability, the estimated arrival time, and the total cost. Any extra work or destination changes should be discussed with the operator.

Will roadside assistance fix the vehicle?+

A roadside service may resolve the immediate issue, but it is not a diagnosis or repair guarantee. If the vehicle needs workshop attention, discuss towing options.
